facts.fact: LoGRI says the Ministry of Construction's SIGFU is digitising all existing paper maps into the ministry's database to modernise land titling.
LoGRI says prospective owners are invited to submit applications for land titles online through SIGFU.

systems.system: SIGFU (Systeme Integre de Gestion du Foncier Urbain)
systems.owner: Ministry of Construction, Housing and Urban Planning
